sections.title: query
sections.sql:
WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT * FROM `football-analytics-dev.football_data.TRANSFERS`
)

, signings AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM transfers
  WHERE to_club_id = 985
)

SELECT *
FROM signings
QUALIFY
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY transfer_season
    ORDER BY transfer_fee DESC
  ) = 1
ORDER BY transfer_date DESC
